content: next-intl middleware pitfalls: (1) matcher config that uses dot-exclusion (to skip static files) silently breaks routes with dots in segments like /users/jane.doe; (2) third-party endpoints like Vercel Analytics /_vercel/insights/view must be explicitly excluded or middleware rewrites them; (3) cookie locale takes precedence over Accept-Language header — if user has stale locale cookie, they get wrong language silently; (4) static export (output:export) disables middleware entirely making locale prefix mandatory and server negotiation impossible; (5) misconfigured localePrefix or domains settings generate wrong hreflang tags.
